notes: The host may verify what the phone produced. It may not testify that the phone did something the host never observed.
A physical Motorola device (ZY22HFN93K) IS reachable via adb; the deployed llc.bonacqui.aptd build was inspected read-only (see G7_DEVICE_INVESTIGATION.json).

The deployed production path (aptd_host_main._form -> FormationCore.ingest) runs a PRE-R-001 FormationCore lacking the allocator-continuation contract; its allocator resets on every load, and this has already produced duplicate family IDs on the device.

Device safety is NOT inferred from host-side passes. G7 remains unsatisfied until a build containing the R-001 id_continuation contract is deployed, the existing state is migrated with an operator receipt, and device formation/restart/export is observed.
